source.description: PROBLEM: smoke prompts like 'summarize this paragraph' pass on many models. Production-shape Mercury Atomic Summarizer prompt (40KB content + role + JSON contract) reveals tool-call hallucinations on glm-5 and qwen3.5-thinking even with all isolation flags. Only kimi-k2.5 survives. Anyone selecting a new model from a smoke test will hit this in production. SUCCESS: docs/model-validation-checklist.md with a representative 30-40KB benchmark prompt, success criteria (canonical schema match, no <think>/<tool_call> tokens), failure-mode catalog. Optional: a 'sp model-validate <model> --bench <fixture>' subcommand. SCOPE: docs + optional CLI helper. NON_GOALS: no model gating in registry. REFERENCE: darth-feedor memory 'pi-llm-model-selection-for-darth-feedor-specialists'.
source.title: Model-validation guide: production-shape prompts, not smoke tests
